body: Know what they do, who their customers are and what the role needs.
Every point on it is a possible question. Have a short, real example ready for each.
"Tell me about yourself." "Why this job?" Say your answers to a friend or a mirror, not just in your head.
Online? Test your camera, mic and internet early. In person? Reach 10 minutes before.
End by asking about the team, or what success looks like in the role.
